title: seat.propose input
description: Propose a temporary helper for Colin's concrete job. Read published seats and projects with registry_read and choose implementation details from their declarations. Ask only about unresolved work or project scope, never for schema fields.

seat.description: Use the requested name or derive a short, distinct name for this temporary helper.

purpose.description: The concrete job from Colin's request and the conversation, not a placeholder task.

template.description: Choose the closest enabled published builder or judge for the job; inspect its tools and project scope yourself. Never copy a conversation seat or widen the template's authority.

projects.description: Resolve the intended project from the request, conversation, or an explicit declared default to published project IDs. Allowed projects alone are not a default; ask only if the intended scope remains unclear.

ttlHours.description: Choose a bounded lifetime of a few hours appropriate to the job unless Colin specifies one; do not ask him for this schema field.

tools.description: The template's tools the temporary seat may use; omitted or empty: all of the template's.
